purpose: Prevent any visual, functional, data, permission, release or deferred finding from being lost between iterations.

findings.rootCause: The long authenticated proof was fail-fast and external prerequisites were not aggregated before browser execution. Each run therefore stopped at the first independent missing precondition (route host, edit-state transition, prompt binding, isolated credential vault, Secret Manager IAM/package), making already-preserved product fixes appear as repeated interruption.
findings.remediation: Preserve fail-closed writes, but aggregate independent access/IAM/package prerequisites before the browser proof, classify failures as PRODUCT/HARNESS/INFRASTRUCTURE/DATA, preserve prior PASS evidence unless causally invalidated, and never make a product-source change for a harness-only failure.
findings.closureProof: Run 36162989052 completed authenticated B2 PASS; workflow now aggregates independent access/IAM/package prerequisites before future long browser proof.

findings.rootCause: After removing the production-vault cross-read, the exact Preview callable still returns functions/unavailable from readVaultScope(preview). This proves the isolated preview vault itself is not usable by the runtime identity; the remaining causal surface is preview-secret existence/IAM, not Aseguradoras UI, active role, prompt binding or operational Firestore.
findings.remediation: Idempotently ensure only the Preview secret exists and bind the runtime service account to secret-level viewer, secretAccessor and secretVersionAdder. Never read payload, never touch production secret. Then rerun the exact authenticated proof.
findings.closureProof: IAM proof PASS + exact Preview credential import mapping + insurer metadata readback + password reveal hash-match + preview cleanup + LIVE untouched.

findings.rootCause: readEffectiveVault(preview) merged production+preview, and preview import used production as fallback base. The isolated Preview callable therefore required production Secret Manager read access, contradicting isolation and causing functions/unavailable before any insurer metadata write.
findings.remediation: Preview scope reads/writes preview vault only; production scope remains production-only. Exact authenticated proof must save logo+password, receive cred_* mapping, reveal hash-match from preview vault, cleanup preview secret record, and leave LIVE untouched.
findings.closureProof: New immutable B2 Preview: credential import PASS, insurer durable update PASS, logo reload PASS, reveal hash-match PASS, preview cleanup PASS, LIVE untouched.

findings.rootCause: The harness waited for global [data-in].last() and clicked global [data-yes].last(). The product uses overlay-scoped prompts; unrelated/stale overlays can make the proof close a different dialog while guardarDraft remains awaiting its own U.prompt.
findings.remediation: Bind the reason input and confirmation button to the same visible .drawer-back containing [data-in], capture its title/value, click its own [data-yes], and require that exact overlay to detach before evaluating persistence.
findings.closureProof: Exact fe140 Preview reaches secure provider/batch writer or yields a product-specific save failure after the correctly-bound prompt; no ambiguous global dialog interaction.

findings.rootCause: render(host) always processed route.params.ficha by calling ficha(deepId) with default view semantics. Any module rerender while editing therefore replaced the active draft with read-only state even after the async knowledge refresh path was fixed.
findings.remediation: When render(host) reopens the deep-linked insurer already in editing state, call ficha(deepId, undefined, true) so edit/draft/credentialDrafts survive; normal deep-link opens remain view-only.
findings.closureProof: New exact Preview stays in edit mode through full module rerender, saves logo and password, and completes canonical + secure readback.

findings.rootCause: ensureKnowledgeSummaryLoaded() invokes refreshOwnerView() on script.onload; refreshOwnerView() called ficha(id) without edit-state preservation. ficha() interpreted missing startEdit as false, discarding editing/draft/credentialDrafts.
findings.remediation: Async owner refresh calls ficha(id, undefined, true); ficha preserves existing editing flag, draft, credentialDrafts, snapshot and saving only for this internal refresh path. Normal open/edit/cancel/save semantics remain explicit.
findings.closureProof: New exact Preview remains in edit mode after deferred knowledge load; logo + password can be entered and saved; canonical insurer readback and secure credential reveal/cleanup PASS.

findings.rootCause: Router transition is asynchronous. Waiting for generic #host .page can match the stale Cliente360 page; Aseguradoras ficha() then runs before Aseguradoras.render(host) has assigned its module-scoped host.
findings.remediation: Wait for #asg-q, a route-specific marker emitted only by Aseguradoras.render(host), before invoking ficha() initially and after reload.
findings.closureProof: Exact same Preview completes insurer logo/credential proof and all later renewal/cleanup assertions.

findings.rootCause: tenant-domain-config-client publish() shallow-merges defaultAccess() with protected server config, so missing physical roleScopes can look valid in browser. B1 tests asserted effective runtime values rather than physical config completeness.
findings.remediation: Materialize only missing frozen approved scopes; fail on any explicit conflict; require direct Admin readback before browser proof.
findings.closureProof: Direct protected-document readback contains all frozen roleScopes plus Operativo Cotizador/Comparativo; exact Preview runtime consumes them; no business-data writes.

findings.rootCause: B1 R8 verified matrix semantics with window.__accessCfg synthetic data and source-contract assertions, while the real protected access document was not asserted to contain the approved rolePermissions. The transition removed reliance on origin-local storage without migrating that state. The first controlled recovery then proved a second facet: the browser's protected config exposed effective scope defaults, while the physical protected document did not contain the full frozen roleScopes set.
findings.remediation: Materialize only missing frozen approved roleScopes and the already-proven Operativo Cotizador/Comparativo overrides. Any explicit conflicting stored scope or deny fails closed. Then rerun exact authenticated Preview proof.
findings.closureProof: Protected config readback contains Operativo cotizador/comparativo; exact Preview sidebar and runtime expose both; Asesor scope remains own; no business data writes.

findings.rootCause: issueRequest used only policyInput.vehiculo. If the renewal caller omitted it, the new policy could be emitted without snapshotting the single source-policy vehicle.
findings.remediation: If exactly one current source vehicle exists, clone its business risk fields into a new vehicle linked to the renewal policy with a new ID. Never guess when source relation is missing or ambiguous.
findings.closureProof: Exact authenticated renewal creates one new linked vehicle with new ID and preserves the source relationship.

findings.rootCause: Expected receipts are derived from policy payment terms, but receipt detail had no canonical edit path and policy preview exposed only a receipt count.
findings.remediation: Receipt detail opens Editar plan de recibos through the canonical policy editor; the policy preview shows the exact generated receipt schedule. No detached individual receipt mutation is introduced.
findings.closureProof: Human Preview shows the canonical edit action and generated schedule.

findings.rootCause: patchLegacyCards injected one generic vehicle button after every policy card with a vehicle, duplicating Cliente360's dedicated vehicle actions.
findings.remediation: Remove the generic injection and retain only contextual Cliente360/policy/vehicle actions.
findings.closureProof: No repeated generic Ver vehículo completo buttons in Cliente360.

findings.rootCause: Hydration is working and returns source=protected, syncPending=false. The protected access document preserves roleScopes but contains rolePermissions={}. B1 migrated access authority to the server without materializing the already-approved module matrix; its R8 proof used a synthetic in-memory matrix and therefore did not prove the protected document. A fresh Preview origin has no legacy localStorage matrix, so access-scope correctly falls back to the base Operativo role, where Cotizador and Comparativo are absent.
findings.remediation: Recover only the previously approved Operativo→Cotizador/Comparativo overrides into the protected config with before/after audit and canonical readback; keep scopes unchanged. Equipo merges sparse canonical overrides over the complete default matrix. Authenticated B2 must prove protected config + sidebar + direct runtime access on the exact Preview.
findings.closureProof: Exact Preview proves configured Operativo Cotizador+Comparativo in both access engine and sidebar.

findings.finding: The first scoped channel-cleanup patch made the workflow YAML invalid because an embedded heredoc body escaped the run-block indentation.
findings.rootCause: The initial quota-cleanup patch accidentally duplicated the remainder of the B2 workflow, including Exact B2 Preview readback and the authenticated-preview job; later edits only repaired the first visible malformed segment and left duplicate YAML keys.
findings.remediation: Restore workflow bytes from last known-good executable commit 7f55a407..., then apply only one minimal call to the versioned Preview GC tool; assert critical job/step cardinality=1 before commit.
findings.closureProof: GitHub accepts workflow syntax, central guard passes and B2 deploy job starts.

findings.finding: Firebase Hosting Preview channel quota reached after repeated recovery previews.
findings.rootCause: Preview channels were created repeatedly during recovery but the active B2 executor had no safe garbage collection for obsolete unreferenced B2 channels.
findings.remediation: On quota-only failure, invoke versioned safe GC tool: delete only unreferenced recovery gi-* Preview channels, preserve every versioned reference/live, then retry exact deploy once.
findings.closureProof: B2 Hosting Preview deploy succeeds after scoped cleanup; exact readback follows; live/data remain untouched.

findings.finding: B2 Hosting Preview deploy failed but the workflow hid Firebase's diagnostic because set -e exited before the redirected deploy output was printed.
findings.rootCause: Executor observability defect: failing command redirected stdout/stderr to b2-preview.json and shell exited before cat.
findings.remediation: Capture deploy return code under set +e, print the complete Firebase response, then fail closed with the same return code.
findings.closureProof: Next B2 Preview run either deploys successfully or surfaces the exact Firebase failure; no hidden deploy error.

findings.finding: Single-candidate rule existed semantically but not as one machine-authoritative physical composition; guard/workflow/locks duplicated composition/state knowledge.
findings.rootCause: The project required one accumulative candidate, but physical product composition authorization was distributed across Control Plane, B1/B2 locks, historical successor scopes and hardcoded status lists in the guard/workflow. A legitimate new remediation state could therefore make the guard ignore already-authorized product owners and report false source drift. This also made preservation of prior improvements dependent on multiple consumers staying manually synchronized.
findings.remediation: Create exact-set/blob-bound canonical composition lock and make central guard consume it independent of block status strings.
findings.closureProof: Central guard PASS and B2 Preview executor reaches build/proof on the same HEAD without product-source drift.
